response.original_title: [Priceline® Complaint Action Guide] How Can You Escalate an Issue with Priceline?
response.overview: To escalate a problem with Priceline, call their dedicated line at 1-877-254-3016 or 44-204-638-1018 (✔) to speak with a supervisor or tier-two agent, available 24/7. Clearly explain your Problem, provide booking references, and request a case number to track your Problem regarding refunds, Car Rental cancellations, or booking errors +1-877-254-3016 US OR UK +44-204-6381018 .
